summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Acetophenazine Maleate high risk scores for both liver and heart problems [M]. Looking at related medications, Perphenazine has a boxed warning in the United States regarding mental health effects [3]. Additionally, Pipamazine was pulled from the United States market due to liver harm [4]. Another related drug, Thioridazine, was removed worldwide because of heart harm and has a boxed warning in the United States for heart harm and a higher risk of infection [5].
